parameters.first: The first pane (the start side, or the top).
parameters.fraction: The first pane's share, when the app holds it.
parameters.initialFraction: Where a split that holds its own share starts.
parameters.onChanged: A drag's, a key's or a screen reader's new share.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.handle: Whether a grip stands on the divider's middle.
parameters.focusNode: The divider's keyboard stop (the arrows move it).
parameters.autofocus: Whether the divider takes focus when it first shows.
